name: forkyard
description: Agent-native Git platform on Cloudflare: many agents, one codebase, forks compared side by side.

scripts.dev: node scripts/ensure-dist.mjs && pnpm --filter @forkyard/worker db:migrate:local && pnpm --filter @forkyard/worker build:types && concurrently -k -n emulate,worker,web -c magenta,yellow,cyan "pnpm emulate" "pnpm --filter @forkyard/worker dev" "pnpm --filter @forkyard/web dev"
scripts.deploy: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @forkyard/worker db:migrate:remote && pnpm --filter @forkyard/worker run deploy
